title: The Legend of El Hombre Lobo: Paul Naschy Werewolf
original_title: The Legend of El Hombre Lobo: Paul Naschy Werewolf
overview: A young woman searches for the graves of her long-lost parents in 1972 Transylvania. She and her friends realize they're about to fall prey to the werewolf and ghouls around them. Made as a tribute to Paul Naschy, king of Spanish horror.
